interpretation: retrospective descriptive review tolerances, not model-selection or arbitrage tests

cov_frob_rel.name: Relative covariance Frobenius error
cov_frob_rel.origin: Working tolerances of 25% and 50% of observed covariance norm.

trace_ratio.name: Model/data surface variance ratio
trace_ratio.origin: Within a factor 1.25, or within a factor two, of observed total variance.

subspace_angle_max.name: Maximum principal-subspace angle (degrees)
subspace_angle_max.origin: Working angular tolerances of 15 and 30 degrees, not confidence bounds.

eig_share_err_k.name: Leading eigenvalue-share L1 error
eig_share_err_k.origin: Total absolute leading-share discrepancies of 10 and 25 percentage points.

spot_corr_abs_error.name: Absolute spot/PC correlation error
spot_corr_abs_error.origin: Working correlation tolerances of 0.10 and 0.20, not significance cutoffs.

forecast_ratio.name: Forecast loss / persistence loss
forecast_ratio.origin: No worse than persistence; warning allows at most 10% deterioration.

fit_in_spread.name: Same-day reconstruction in-spread fraction
fit_in_spread.origin: Working reconstruction goals: at most 1 in 20, or 1 in 5, prices outside the spread.

fit_outside_mean.name: Same-day mean outside-spread distance
fit_outside_mean.origin: Working distances of one-quarter and one full quoted spread width.

fit_outside_q95.name: Same-day 95th-percentile outside distance
fit_outside_q95.origin: Working tail distances of one and two full quoted spread widths.

window_deterioration.name: Relative forecast-skill deterioration
window_deterioration.origin: Working deterioration tolerances of 10% and 25%, after scaling by contemporaneous persistence risk.

acf_abs_error.name: Absolute floating-IV PC ACF error
acf_abs_error.origin: Working ACF tolerances of 0.10 and 0.20; fewer than 30 observed lag pairs forces at least warning.

ar_radius.name: PCA AR spectral radius
ar_radius.origin: Stationarity boundary is one. The .99 proximity warning corresponds to a modal half-life of about 69 sessions.

invalid_rate.name: Invalid decoded path fraction
invalid_rate.origin: No invalid paths is the target; up to 1% is a numerical warning, beyond 1% a review failure.

extreme_rate.name: Fraction of surfaces with IV above 300%
extreme_rate.origin: 300% IV is the stated sanity threshold; any occurrence warns and more than 0.1% fails this finite-horizon screen.

tail_coverage.test: two-sided exact binomial; pointwise, exploratory, no across-model multiplicity correction
